title: Hoospec public deployment settings
description: Public settings only. Never place access tokens or client secrets in this file. Empty instance/project/branch values inherit GitLab CI defaults.

paths.description: Repository-relative directories. Existing documents keep their paths; these directories control discovery and new generated files.

specs.description: Gherkin search and output directory. Empty string searches the whole repository and creates new specs at its root.

adrs.description: ADR search and output directory. Empty string disables ADR discovery and creates new ADRs at the repository root.

workspace.description: Directory for canonical workspace.json, including history. Must not be empty.
